barcode-decoder.mjs is a minified ESM bundle of:

  @zxing/browser  (https://github.com/zxing-js/browser)
  @zxing/library  (https://zxing.github.io/zxing-js/)

License: Apache License 2.0 (ZXing-js project).

Regenerate with:  npm install && npm run build:vendor

The bundle is committed so the application runs with no build step and
without any third-party CDN.
